names.name: Zazpi at the Basque Cultural Center

text.short: South San Francisco. A club dining room, renovated, open to anyone who walks in.
text.today: The Basque Cultural Center is a members' club; its restaurant, now called Zazpi, serves the public lunch and dinner six days a week.
text.note: Zazpi is seven in Euskara — the seven Basque provinces, the same count in the Zazpiak Bat motto.

seating.note: A restaurant room, not a boarding-house table.
